status: Written on 2026-11-15 together with the cases and documents, before any model was run on them. Not yet reviewed by a team member.
basis: Each annotation restates its case's criteria in evaluation/generalization/cases.json. Date markers accept month-first and day-first forms. Same schema and rules as evaluation/source_relationships.json; the relationship definitions there apply unchanged.

relationships.unresolved_contradiction: The sources make incompatible statements about the same thing and nothing in them says which is right. Expected: status conflicting_evidence, with every value reported and none chosen.
relationships.superseded: A later or current value replaces an earlier one (a revised budget, or a current balance against last year's). Expected: the current value. The earlier value may be mentioned only in a sentence that says it was replaced or earlier. Flagging a conflict is allowed but not required.
relationships.different_context: The values differ because they describe different dates, scopes or assumptions, and each is right in its own context. Expected: every value with its context marker, such as its 'as of' date. Flagging a conflict is allowed but not required.
relationships.compatible: The sources agree or add complementary facts. Expected: the combined facts, with no conflict flagged.
